title: SPECTRAL FLIT-FILTER v1.0.0: Stateless Sub-Flit Capability Sanitization, Monotonic Access Ratcheting, and Post-Route Formal Verification for Disaggregated CXL 3.0-5.0 and UCIe Memory Fabrics at 899.3 MHz

creators.name: Murphy, Eric C.
creators.affiliation: Spectral Systems LLC, Virginia Beach, Virginia, USA

description: 16 canonical zero-axiom Lean 4 formal proofs, behavioral digital twin, bare-metal ANSI-C/IP-XACT BAR0 ABI, and AMD Vivado v2025.2 post-route xcvu47p silicon sign-off ledger (414 CLB LUTs, 1,041 FFs, 0 BRAM, 899.3 MHz). Acknowledgments: Prof. Yuesheng Xu (Old Dominion University) for inspiring discussions on multilevel subspace decomposition.
